methods.what: Definition of a Gauss-type sum combining cube roots of unity and n-th roots of unity via a primitive root
Cube of the sum expressed via the representation 4n = M² + 27N²
Normalisation of M and relation of M/N to powers of the primitive root
Frobenius-type congruence for P raised to p², giving the cubic character via the index of p
Criterion for cubic residue character of p mod n in terms of M/(3N)
Cubic character of 2 mod n in terms of M/(3N)
Case distinction for n = μ²+27ν²: if 3|ν then 2 is a cubic residue

items.english: Second case: μ+ν divisible by 3; then 2^{(n-1)/3} ≡ -1/2 + (1/2)μ/ν.
